# monotaur_notification_channel (Resource)

Manages a Monotaur notification channel. A channel sends the events it subscribes to straight to Slack, Microsoft Teams, email, PagerDuty or any HTTPS endpoint, rendered with Scriban templates.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# Slack: the incoming webhook URL is the credential.
resource "monotaur_notification_channel" "oncall_slack" {
  name        = "On-call Slack"
  type        = "Slack"
  event_types = ["com.monotaur.alarm.triggered", "com.monotaur.alarm.cleared"]
  credential  = var.slack_webhook_url
}

# Email: no credential; 1 to 20 recipients; optional custom subject.
resource "monotaur_notification_channel" "ops_email" {
  name             = "Ops email"
  type             = "Email"
  event_types      = ["com.monotaur.component.status-changed"]
  recipients       = ["ops@example.com", "On-call <oncall@example.com>"]
  subject_template = "[Monotaur] {{ summary }}"
}

# Generic webhook with a custom JSON body (must render valid JSON).
resource "monotaur_notification_channel" "webhook" {
  name          = "Incident bridge"
  type          = "Webhook"
  event_types   = ["com.monotaur.alarm.triggered"]
  credential    = "https://example.com/hooks/monotaur"
  body_template = "{\"summary\": {{ summary | object.to_json }}}"
  enabled       = true
}

variable "slack_webhook_url" {
  type      = string
  sensitive = true
}
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Required

- `event_types` (Set of String) The CloudEvent types delivered to the channel (at least one), e.g. `com.monotaur.alarm.triggered`. `com.monotaur.alarm.acknowledged` and `com.monotaur.alarm.note-added` are webhook-subscription only and not accepted.
- `name` (String) The display name of the channel (1 to 200 characters), also `channel.name` in templates.
- `type` (String) What the channel delivers to: one of `Slack`, `Teams`, `Email`, `PagerDuty`, `Webhook`. Cannot be changed after creation; changing it destroys and recreates the channel.

### Optional

- `body_template` (String) Scriban template of the message body (at most 10,000 characters); for `Webhook` it must render JSON. When unset, the type's default template is used.
- `credential` (String, Sensitive) The Slack, Teams or webhook URL (must be `https`), or the PagerDuty Events API v2 integration key. Required for those types and not allowed for `Email`. Sensitive and write-only: the API never returns it, so the value from the configuration is kept in state, drift is not detected, and `terraform import` cannot recover it (the next apply re-sends the configured value). Removing it from the configuration does not clear it on the server.
- `enabled` (Boolean) Whether the channel sends notifications. Defaults to `true` on the server. Delivery sets it to `false` after too many failed deliveries in a row; setting it to `true` again resets `consecutive_failure_count` and `auto_disabled_date_time`.
- `recipients` (List of String) Email addresses (`ops@example.com` or `Ops <ops@example.com>`), 1 to 20. Required for `Email` channels and not allowed for the other types.
- `subject_template` (String) Scriban template of the email subject, the PagerDuty alert summary or the Teams card title (at most 10,000 characters). Not allowed for `Slack` and `Webhook`. When unset, the type's default template is used.

### Read-Only

- `auto_disabled_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when delivery disabled the channel after too many failures, or null (system-managed, read-only).
- `consecutive_failure_count` (Number) Deliveries in a row that ended `Failed` (system-managed, read-only).
- `create_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the channel was created (assigned by the API).
- `id` (String) The unique identifier of the notification channel (assigned by the API).
- `update_date_time` (String) The RFC 3339 timestamp when the channel was last updated (assigned by the API).
